[RDSC.5a.7g.3] `max_samples` carries the reservoir capacity `n`.
`window_ns` is `0`: a reservoir has no time axis and is bounded by `n`,
not by a window, so there is no time-based eviction. Retention uses a
**fixed-seed** `xorshift64` PRNG (seed `0x9e3779b97f4a7c15`), advanced
once per absorbed sample in event-trace order.
